description: Berlin Airlift veteran operated as a flying memorial by the Berlin Airlift Historical Foundation; wrecked by an April 2020 tornado at Walterboro South Carolina; cut up for road transport and reassembled on the brewery grounds at 688 Brewing Drive where a September 2025 feature and an OSM node dated 2025 place it; being rebuilt as a bar and exhibit; FAA registry gives model C54-D serial 43-17228 year 1943 - the serial block is normally quoted as C-54B so the variant is unresolved
aliases: N500EJ; Spirit of Freedom; C-54B; C54; C54D; C54B
museum_name: Aviator Hangar Bar and Brewery -- Fuquay-Varina
